title: Edit PDF object transforms: move, resize, replace, delete existing objects
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-edit; move, resize, replace and delete existing text blocks and image XObjects on a real page, proven by a PDFium render before/after and by session undo/redo; the selection overlay and handles are T-0264 and EDIT-004 stays library until the GUI verifies it
notes: Completes A-23 (Edit PDF: add/move/resize/replace/delete), which T-0233 deliberately left at EDIT-004 `model` after shipping add-text and add-image. Library ops: enumerate selectable objects (text runs/blocks and image XObjects) with page rectangles; move (translate the placement matrix / Tm); resize (scale about the object box); replace (new text contents for a run/block, new image data for an XObject); delete (remove the operator or the XObject usage and its orphaned resource entry). Every operation goes through the caller's pdfxi-document session snapshot so undo/redo works, and is proven by rendering before and after through PDFium in tests, not only by re-extraction. Update EDIT-004 to `library` only when all four operations are real; a shell task follows for the selection overlay and handles.
